description: What InternetData knows about one autonomous system, by its number: its operator, country, registry, allocation date and domain, the kind of network it runs, how many IPv4 addresses and prefixes it announces with their RPKI counts, its ASN Whois record, and the prefixes it announces in global BGP with their RPKI status: the first 100, with `truncated` giving the total where it announces more. An AS no database knows comes back as its number with empty values. Unlimited, the free plan, answers its operator, country, registry, allocation date and domain, with a key or without one. Every paid plan answers every field, and so does a key on the free plan while its organization's daily trial lasts. Always read `coverage.note` before concluding anything from a field that is not in the result.
name: lookup_asn

coverage.description: Which datasets this result covered. Read `note` before interpreting any absent field.

result.description: What every database says about one AS.

country.description: The country its registry assigned it to.

num_ips.description: IPv4 addresses it announces. Paid plans and the trial.

num_prefixes4.description: IPv4 prefixes it announces. Paid plans and the trial.

num_prefixes6.description: IPv6 prefixes it announces. Paid plans and the trial.

prefixes.description: What it announces, IPv4 then IPv6, up to 20000 a family. Paid plans and the trial.

first_seen.description: The first day BGP Route saw it.

size.description: IPv4 addresses it covers; 0 for IPv6.

rpki_invalid.description: Invalid. Paid plans and the trial.

rpki_not_found.description: With no RPKI record. Paid plans and the trial.

rpki_valid.description: Its announcements RPKI calls valid. Paid plans and the trial.

trial_expired.description: On every answer to a key on the free plan, and on no other: `false` while the day's trial of every field lasts, `true` once the answer has Unlimited's fields.

type.description: The kind of network it runs. Paid plans and the trial.

whois.description: Its ASN Whois record, every column, empty where the registry states nothing. Paid plans and the trial.

truncated.description: Present only when the answer was cut short: the prefixes it carries, how many the AS announces, and where to get them all.

title: Look up an AS
